title: At 27, Druckenmiller Bet Everything on One Trade
description:
Build your first live trading algorithm 👉https://cryptomomentumgroup.com/

Druckenmiller at 27 put everything into oil and defense stocks when the Shah of Iran fell, and the market called him a genius when it worked. His own verdict is that he wasn't a genius, he just didn't know any better. Concentrated bets that pay off still teach the wrong lesson, and that's why systematic traders diversify by design
